source: type Getter = <T, K extends keyof T>(x: T, k: K) => T[K]; type NumberGetter = (x: { value: number }, k: "value") => number; type WrongGetter = (x: { value: number }, k: "value") => string; interface View<T> { key: keyof T; value: T[keyof T] } type ViewNumber = View<{ value: number }>; type PlainView = { key: "value"; value: number };
